Live file 08 confirms it: DR-131 NT classes are named at G24/G25/G26/G27/G28 and NT-4 at none. Since G23 owns DR-133 NT-3, listing NT-4 as not-executed would have been the error. Recorded so a coordinator can see the question was asked and answered from live bytes.

decision.scopeOfAccept: This ACCEPT is of harness.DR-G23.provider-well-formed-admission.preview.v1 as a leftover-design specification of exact-byte intent for the three live DR-G23 retained-evidence members and the one live harness-cell corpus, covering DR-133 NT-3 and NT-5 for the TypeScript provider on the four D-002 platforms, at status CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED. It is not an execution of NT-3 or NT-5, not a seal, not a SATISFIED of DR-133 or DR-131, and not a QUALIFIED. Leftover-design of NT-3 and NT-5 as unnamed remainders stays closed at D-147, not here; leftover-design of OBL-G23-HARNESS-SPEC closes only on independent ACCEPT plus a later D-000 recording.
decision.summaryForCoordinator: No blockers, no SHOULD-FIX. The one candidate finding was real enough to chase and did not survive: doesNotExecute.dr131 omits NT-4, the single DR-131 class whose pass reads 'Refused under DR-133', from an otherwise exhaustive denial list. No gate owns DR-131 NT-4, and that is by established standing - the D-150 and D-151 verdicts both record it as 'discharged by named DR-133 classes' because executing DR-133 NT-1/NT-2/NT-3 exercises the refusal. Since G23 owns DR-133 NT-3, listing NT-4 as not-executed would have been the error; the omission is correct. Everything else verified against live bytes: 18/18 cited digests; all seven G23 cell carries plus the whole 584-character row exact; all seven quoted sibling rows exact, including the g20 claim that the live DR-G20 row contains 'Coverage' zero times, which I confirmed; the three-member semicolon split derived and rejoined exactly, with EV-2 and EV-3 kept as a genuine partition of v3's one NT-5 sentence; NT-3 and NT-5 name/input/pass verbatim from v3, and all four consumed product-law quotes resolving to exact v3 nodes, with v3's acceptance-evidence quote still exact against the live DR-133 cell; D-147 confirmed clause by clause including PAL-V1-A1; naming v6 confirmed to contain no G23 at all; the unadopted D-143 G23 draft disclosed rather than inherited. Every NT token used exists in a live corpus - no invented number - and there is no QUALIFIED, SATISFIED, Rust-as-core, D9 code, finding schema or 7.1 recipe anywhere. 30 attacks run, 30 refuted.
